source: curated by hand (2026-11-14, agent-knowledge.md K2 batch c or d) with tools/k2c_knowledge.py, from the profile by tools/machine-profiler.py on windows, 2026-11-14 and the evidence listed
summary: A spectrum and level display: it analyses the audio (left, right or mix) with a chosen FFT window and shows low, mid and high bands, volume, balance and correlation in its own window.
use_for: A spectrum and level display with its own window.
quirks: It is a display: it makes no sound and changes nothing; its numbers are for looking at, in its own Windows window. analyze_mix and meters_read give the same readings through the tools.
Unverified: what Display scale scales, and which audio it listens to when nothing is connected to it.
Closed source (a prebuilt DLL): names come from its own texts, its DLL's type names and the profile, not from code.
evidence: its parameter descriptions and value texts (machine_describe, as profiled)
RunTime/Gear/Generators/SpectrumBlock.NET.dll — type and member names read from the DLL (the analyser window)
profile (tools/machine-profiler.py, windows 2026-11-14) - a control machine, no sound

parameters.name: Channel
parameters.description: Chooses which channel is analysed: Left, Right or Mix (the default).
parameters.how: Chooses which channel is analysed: Left, Right or Mix (the default).
parameters.sound: It decides which side of the audio the spectrum and level displays show.

parameters.name: Window
parameters.description: Apply windowing to the audio prior to FFT analysis.
parameters.how: Chooses the window applied to the audio before its spectrum is analysed: None, Hanning, Hamming, Blackman, Blackman exact, Blackman-Harris, flat top, Bartlett or Cosine; None is the default.
parameters.sound: A smoother window gives a cleaner spectrum with less leakage between bands; None shows the raw frame.

parameters.name: Low (Hz)
parameters.description: Spectrum frequency low range ceiling Hz.
parameters.how: Sets the ceiling of the low band for the display, 0 to 22,050 Hz (300 Hz by default).
parameters.sound: It sets where the low-frequency meter stops and the mid band begins.

parameters.name: High (Hz)
parameters.description: Spectrum frequency high range floor Hz.
parameters.how: Sets the floor of the high band for the display, 0 to 22,050 Hz (2,400 Hz by default).
parameters.sound: It sets where the high-frequency meter begins; the mid band is between the two.

parameters.name: LowVisible
parameters.description: Shows or hides the low band meter, No or Yes (Yes by default).
parameters.how: Shows or hides the low band meter, No or Yes (Yes by default).
parameters.sound: It changes the display only, not the sound.

parameters.name: MidVisible
parameters.description: Shows or hides the mid band meter, No or Yes (Yes by default).
parameters.how: Shows or hides the mid band meter, No or Yes (Yes by default).
parameters.sound: It changes the display only, not the sound.

parameters.name: HighVisible
parameters.description: Shows or hides the high band meter, No or Yes (Yes by default).
parameters.how: Shows or hides the high band meter, No or Yes (Yes by default).
parameters.sound: It changes the display only, not the sound.

parameters.name: VolumeVisible
parameters.description: Shows or hides the volume graph, No or Yes (Yes by default).
parameters.how: Shows or hides the volume graph, No or Yes (Yes by default).
parameters.sound: It changes the display only, not the sound.

parameters.name: BalanceVisible
parameters.how: Shows or hides the stereo balance display, No or Yes (Yes by default).
parameters.sound: It changes the display only, not the sound.

parameters.name: CorrCoeVisible
parameters.how: Shows or hides the correlation coefficient display, No or Yes (Yes by default).
parameters.sound: It changes the display only, not the sound.

parameters.name: VolSmooth (ms)
parameters.how: Sets the length of the volume graph's smoothing buffer, 1 to 100 ms (10 ms by default).
parameters.sound: A longer buffer gives a calmer volume trace; a short one follows every peak.

parameters.name: Scale
parameters.description: Sets the display scale, 1 to 100 (10 by default); what it scales was not measured.
parameters.how: Sets the display scale, 1 to 100 (10 by default); what it scales was not measured.
parameters.sound: It changes the display only, not the sound.
